sampling.method: Deterministic label-stratified sample with every rare NOT_FULFILLED item and at least one item from every flow. Per-item primary labels and model predictions are withheld.

label_definitions.FULFILLED: All core UI-observable claims are visibly supported by the ordered screenshot flow.
label_definitions.PARTIALLY_FULFILLED: A material observable part is supported, but at least one core observable part is unsupported or unresolved.
label_definitions.NOT_FULFILLED: The ordered screenshot flow visibly contradicts at least one core observable claim.
label_definitions.ABSTAIN: The screenshots do not provide enough visible evidence for a safe positive, partial, or contradictory decision.

review_instructions: Review items independently and in audit_item_id order.
Do not inspect primary-author labels or model predictions.
Use only UI-observable evidence in the supplied ordered screenshots.
Do not infer backend correctness, persistence, security, completeness, or external effects.
Record all decisive screenshot step numbers.
Set reviewer_confidence to LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH.

items.requirement_text: The system shall retain the selected park context in later purchase and checkout screens so users can verify that they are still completing a pass purchase for the intended park.

The system shall provide a final editable review step before commitment where the purchaser can inspect and revise the selected park, pass tier, passholder details, dining add-ons, and payment choice.
The system shall present season pass tiers side by side with pricing and benefit information to support plan comparison.

The system shall present multiple dining-plan variants with pricing so the user ca
n compare optional add-ons.
The system shall support stepwise progression through the checkout flow with consistent back and continue navigation controls.
The system shall collect billing and contact details needed to complete the payment agreement workflow.
The system shall present prices and option details transparently enough for users to compare pass tiers, add-ons, and payment choices during checkout.
The system shall preserve a user's selected home store as the default store context on all pages and on a subsequent visit.
The system shall provide a clear mechanism for users to access the store locator functionality.
The system shall allow users to create a job alert directly from their current search and filter context so future matching openings can be delivered without re-entering the criteria.
The system shall provide visible confirmation that a selected job posting has been handed off to the chosen external sharing channel or compose surface.
The system shall ensure that every job shown after search and filtering satisfies all selected criteria across the complete result set, not only the initially visible listings.
The system shall provide a dedicated careers area from which users can access job openings and related applicant resources.
The system shall support combining multiple filter criteria to narrow job results.
The system shall support sharing job postings through external channels such as social media and email.
The system shall make all supported eGift card denominations visibly available within the purchase flow rather than exposing only a partial subset of purchasable amounts.

The system shall display a synchronized purchase summary on the eGift card purchase page that visibly updates the currently selected amount and entered delivery details as the shopper configures the card.
The system shall allow access to editable profile settings only for the authenticated account owner.
The system shall warn users about unsaved profile changes before they leave the editing flow.
The system shall mark roles as featured or hiring only when those openings are still actively accepting applications.
The system shall provide a review step that summarizes the selected park and opening before the applicant commits to starting the application.

The system shall provide direct in-page filtering or refinement within a selected park's opportunities, such as narrowing visible openings by department, job type, or similar criteria instead of relying only on static category entry points.
The system shall clearly distinguish which contribution resources are generally browsable and which submission work areas require an authenticated contributor account.

The system shall provide an explicit transition from the release submission overview into the actual submission workflow so contributors can proceed directly from learning the rules to starting a release submission.
The system shall let authenticated contributors return directly from submission guidance pages to their submissions or drafts work areas without restarting from the main dashboard.
The system shall allow users to navigate from general experience browsing into onboard travel information pages.
The system shall provide route or region specific café menu resources in addition to a national menu.

The system shall present a centralized gift card service area that groups major gift card related actions, like purchasing gift cards, checking balances, accessing terms and FAQs, and handling membership or corporate gift card options.
The system shall validate gift card lookup inputs and provide inline error feedback when the entered card information does not meet format expectations.
The system shall return the remaining gift card balance after the user provides valid card credentials.
The system shall clearly indicate the downstream delivery destination or channel for digital tickets, such as email or mobile wallet, before the user proceeds to payment.
The system shall provide a dedicated pre-checkout review step where the user can confirm or change the selected ticket fulfillment method before continuing to payment.
The system shall support selection of a digital or mobile ticket fulfillment option as part of the purchase flow.
The system shall return all cruises that satisfy the configured destination, departure port, sailing month, and duration criteria, without omitting any eligible sailings.
The system shall provide a dedicated pre-search review step or summary panel that lists all selected cruise criteria together and allows the user to edit any one of them before submitting the search.
The system shall allow the user to filter cruises by an exact itinerary length in days in addition to broad duration bands.
The system shall allow the user to choose a sail-from location from a list of departure ports.
The system shall return cruise results that reflect the combined selected destination, departure port, month, and duration after the search is submitted.
The system shall provide a dedicated review state before executing advanced search in which the configured bibliographic and language criteria can be checked, edited, or cleared.
The system shall provide an explicit action to submit configured advanced search criteria.
The system shall allow signed-in users to save coupon discoveries to favorites and revisit them from account-level areas in later use.
The system shall carry the resolved canonical location label and active search term forward onto later coupon discovery views so users can confirm or revise the current search context.
The system shall allow users to pursue coupon discovery for a searched business category within a chosen locality.
The system shall assist geographic disambiguation by presenting multiple matching locations, including city and neighborhood-level options, when a location is ambiguous.
